During the cold snap in Afghanistan in January 2023, temperatures reached as low as -33 °C (-27 °F) and snowfall was as high as 30 centimeters (12 in) in more mountainous regions. 

The cold snap killed at least 160 people, making it the deadliest weather event of 2023 until Cyclone Freddy. Additionally, nearly 80,000 livestock were killed.
